only_changes_from_long_prereg_rmap.json: Generator (rmap2_lib.py): the planted signal no longer feeds back into x. The input x is the linear process of rmap_lib (a = 0). The target is y[t+1] = x[t+1] + a g_t.
g_t has its linear projection on [1, x_t, mean10, mean50] removed (so HAR cannot pick it up) and is scaled to unit variance on the same path; a = sqrt(s/(1-s)).
Output folders rmap2_preds/, rmap2_logs/, report files rmap2_report.*.

Everything else unchanged and diff-checked: cells, reps, seeds, students, tuning, readout, splits, statistics, categories, Holm families, decision rules W0-W3, pipeline check, copper placement rule, captured-gain table.
